title: Implement Custom 'myInstanceOf' Operator
problemStatement: Implement `myInstanceOf(instance, Constructor)` that mimics the native `instanceof` operator by walking `instance`'s prototype chain checking for `Constructor.prototype`.
interviewTrap: Primitives (`myInstanceOf('string', String)`) return false because `instanceof` only checks object instances, not primitive values.

testCases.name: Walks up multiple prototype inheritance tiers

details.name: Walks up multiple prototype inheritance tiers

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Every JS object has an internal `[[Prototype]]` link. Property lookup walks this chain until the property is found or `null` is reached (`Object.prototype.__proto__ === null`). Modifying a property on an instance creates an 'own property' shadowing the prototype's property.
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Initialize execution context and environment records for ECMAScript instanceof Algorithm & Prototype Comparison.
2. Execute logic adhering to ECMAScript standard specification.
3. Verify invariant boundaries and edge conditions.
